title: International Filings and the Madrid Protocol
short: Protection for Indian brands abroad and Indian protection for foreign brand owners, through the Madrid system and a network of associates.
intro: Indian businesses now sell, manufacture and license abroad from early in their lives, and foreign brands enter India expecting counsel that works the way their home firms do. We handle both directions: international filings for Indian applicants through the Madrid Protocol and national routes, and Indian filings, prosecution and enforcement for foreign applicants and their counsel.

We advise on where to file and in what order, manage foreign associates where national filings are needed, respond to provisional refusals, and keep a single consolidated docket so that a brand owner sees its worldwide position in one place.
services: International applications under the Madrid Protocol with India as the office of origin
Filing strategy across jurisdictions: Madrid versus national routes, timing, priority and budgets
Management of national filings abroad through a vetted network of foreign associates
Indian designations of international registrations, including responses to provisional refusals
Indian filings, prosecution, oppositions and enforcement for foreign applicants and law firms
Subsequent designations, transformation and replacement under the Madrid system
Consolidated worldwide docketing and status reporting
Advice on foreign brand clearance before export or launch
